text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Periodic exams... a trial that no student 
at Tracen Academy can ever escape—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
For this problem... ugh~, whaddya even do 
here~...??

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, Maya figured it out! If we put 
this and this together~

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it untied! That's in-cre-dible~! 
Leave it to Maya-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're done solving the problems, 
let's go hang out, Yukippe, Curren-chan! 
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-But, I reckon I need ta study a bit 
more...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be an awesome "City Girl" in both 
races and tests, just like City-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Right now, Yukino-chan is sparkling 
so brightly and looking so cute♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Trying your hardest to become even cuter? 
Curren totally gives that a "Like"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-Hawawa! You're praising me too much...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Look, the photo of Curren 
and everyone studying together has tons of 
UmaLikes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's gonna sparkle even more! Maya'll 
get better grades and become way more 
mature!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪ Well then, once tests are over, 
let's all go hang out as even cuter 
versions of ourselves♪
